title: Community of Destiny
next_chapter_hook: The moment the oaths of the crowd fell, the fifth page of the Tianji Record abruptly unfurled, and the ultimate prophecy that emerged upon it guided everyone's fate toward the abyss of the final decisive battle—and in the next instant, a terrifying aura that transcended ten thousand years came crashing down from the Nine Heavens.

text.content: From the Nine Heavens above, those countless eyes like materialized Heavenly Dao will condensed into an intangible crushing pressure that enveloped the entire Tianqing Sect ruins. Chen Ji felt his crown as if gripped by an invisible giant hand, each breath weighing him down like carrying mountains. Heavenly Fate Value plummeted at this moment—ten points, twenty points, thirty points—as if some terrifying existence was remotely siphoning his life origin. He gritted his teeth, veins bulging on his forehead, yet not a single groan escaped him. Ten breaths later, that scrutinizing pressure suddenly receded, but the chill of being watched had seared deep into his divine soul. Mo Xiansheng's voice rang in his mind, carrying unprecedented solemnity: 'It has seen you. From this moment forth, you have no secrets left.'

dialogue.content: Chen Ji slowly raised his head, wiping blood from his mouth. His eyes blazed even sharper than before. From his chest, he retrieved a transmission talisman already prepared, infusing it with spiritual energy: 'Everyone, there's no need to hide any longer. What was destined to arrive has arrived—it's time for everyone to gather.' His voice remained tranquil as still water, but the resolve within made any listener's heart tremble. Three breaths later, a piercing sound broke through the distant sky.

Su Qingyao's form descended like a startled swan, landing before Chen Ji. Her white garments were stained with blood, killing intent still lingering between her brows, yet her expression softened instantly upon seeing his ashen complexion. 'You've used the Tianji Record again?' she frowned, voice carrying suppressed anguish, 'How many times have I told you, Heavenly Fate Value isn't meant to be squandered like this!' She retrieved a crystalline elixir from her storage bag, pressing it into Chen Ji's palm without ceremony, 'Take this first. Everything else can wait.'

Demonic Path mist churned as Ye Qing stepped forward. Yet this time, the black qi surrounding her seemed denser than ever, as if something within her was struggling to break free. 'I arrived late.' Her voice carried rare weariness as she regarded Chen Ji with complex, unspoken feelings, 'That moment just now... I sensed it. A presence far superior to me was watching you.' She hesitated. 'That being... even the Holy Sect wouldn't dare provoke it.'

text.content: Suddenly, the Tianji Record Fragment emitted a clear chime. Chen Ji looked down to see an illusory light and shadow gathering on the fifth page—a young girl's form, delicate yet stubborn, bearing a seven-point resemblance to Chen Ji. 'Brother...' The shadow spoke, voice trembling between tears and forced composure, 'I finally found you. All these years, I've been searching...' Chen Ling—Chen Ji's sister, bearer of the Heavenly Fate Lock Key—had finally connected with her brother through some special means.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji gazed at the shadow, throat tightening, but swiftly contained his emotions. Stepping forward, he gently stroked the illusory outline, his fingers passing through the shadow touching nothing, yet his voice brimmed with tenderness: 'Silly girl, you've suffered all these years. Once this is over, brother will take you home.' He turned to everyone present, the softness in his eyes vanishing instantly, replaced by a chilling sharpness: 'Everyone, I've summoned you today to discuss a matter of life and death.'

Ye Qing suddenly stepped forward, interrupting Chen Ji's words. Drawing a deep breath, as if having made an enormous decision, she spoke in a low, difficult tone: 'Before hearing your plan, I must first reveal a truth—about myself.' She lifted her gaze. Those perpetually enchanting eyes now burned with pain and resolve: 'I... have never been a Holy Sect saint. I was created. A being far superior to the Heavenly Dao's Eye, created as a chess piece to set the board in this world.' Her voice trembled: 'And you, Chen Ji, the reason you could foresee my prophecies... is precisely because I was the eye it planted beside you.'

text.content: The moment her words fell, Su Qingyao's hand was already on her sword hilt, murderous intent surging. The demonic mist churned violently—Ye Qing's subordinates had clearly received the shock. Yet Chen Ji simply watched her calmly, eyes betraying not a trace of surprise. 'I know.' His voice was terrifyingly composed: 'From the moment we first met, I knew.' Ye Qing's head snapped up, disbelief flooding her features. A faint smile tugged at Chen Ji's lips—that knowing, almost mocking expression: 'You think my Tianji Record is mere decoration? Every glance you've cast my way felt like a signal to somewhere. That hidden gaze upon you, not even the Heavenly Dao's Eye could fully conceal—how could I not have noticed?'

dialogue.content: Su Qingyao coldly said: 'Since you knew all along, why keep her beside you? This is nurturing a tiger to cause harm!' Her hand tightly gripped the sword hilt, knuckles white. Chen Ji turned to look at Su Qingyao, the sharpness in his eyes softening slightly: 'Qingyao, do you think anyone in this world can completely escape the manipulation of the chessboard?' His voice carried a hint of bitterness: 'Me, the Heavenly Dao's Eye, even that supreme being... we're all chess pieces. The only difference is who overturns the board first.'

choice.prompt: Ye Qing has revealed herself as a chess piece of a higher existence, and Chen Ji had known all along yet chose to keep her by his side. Now Su Qingyao questions this decision—how should one choose?

choices.description: Since she chose to confess, she has chosen to betray that existence. I choose to trust her unconditionally and welcome her formally into our ranks.
choices.visible_cost: Losing an eye that monitors the enemy
choices.visible_reward: Gaining a true ally while being able to exploit the special connection on her body in reverse
choices.risk_hint: If she turns against us, we will lose our final chance for early warning

dialogue.content: Ye Qing froze. She stared at Chen Ji, eyes suddenly reddening. How many years had it been? From the moment she was created, no existence had ever treated her as 'one of their own.' She was merely a chess piece, an eye that needed to be watched. 'You... you truly are willing to believe me?' Her voice trembled, carrying不敢相信的脆弱。

text.content: Chen Ji nodded, his voice calm yet resolute: 'The moment you chose to confess, you had already made your choice. A chess piece wanting to become human—this is your answer to me.' He gazed at Ye Qing, his eyes profound: 'From now on, you are no longer anyone's eye—you are my ally.'

choices.description: Trust requires time to verify. I accept her confession but do not fully trust her for now, keeping measures to control her.
choices.visible_reward: Ensuring countermeasures even if she turns against us
choices.risk_hint: Her loyalty improvement will slow, and she may develop reservations

dialogue.content: A flash of disappointment crossed Ye Qing's eyes, but was quickly replaced by understanding. She lowered her gaze, her voice soft: 'I understand. If our positions were reversed, I wouldn't easily trust someone who had once betrayed.' She raised her hand to her brow center, extracting a strand of essence blood that transformed into a pitch-black token drifting toward Chen Ji: 'This is a strand of my fundamental life soul. With it in your possession, my life and death rest within your single thought.'

text.content: Chen Ji took the token and stored it in the Tianji Record. He looked at Ye Qing, his tone softening somewhat: "This is not distrust; this is being responsible to each other. After this battle, if you're still willing to stay, we can talk about real trust."

choices.description: Since we are forming an alliance, I must show the greatest sincerity. I will bind my Heavenly Fate with yours, sharing life and death.
choices.visible_cost: The Heavenly Fate value will be shared equally with you, and any injury will be mutual.
choices.visible_reward: Gaining a bond of life-and-death partnership, she will become your most steadfast support.
choices.risk_hint: Your weaknesses will be completely exposed to her.

dialogue.content: Ye Qing was utterly shocked. Her eyes widened as she stared at Chen Ji, her voice trembling: "You... do you know what this means? This means your life and death are bound to mine! If I die, you will be injured too! You're handing me your greatest weakness?"

text.content:
Chen Ji simply smiled faintly, drawing a mysterious rune in the air: "That's precisely why I must do this." His voice was calm yet resonant, "If you betray me, you must first kill me; if you want to protect me, you must give your all. From this day forward, our fates intertwine."

The rune pierced Ye Qing's brow, and an uncanny connection formed between them—they could sense each other's heartbeat, breath, even emotional fluctuations.

Su Qingyao observed this scene, quietly withdrawing her hand from her sword hilt. Her gaze toward Chen Ji was complex and profound. After a long moment, she sighed softly: "You're always like this. Calculating everyone meticulously, yet never leaving yourself a single path of retreat."

She stepped forward, standing beside Chen Ji, her voice soft yet firm: "Since you choose to trust her, I too will trust your judgment. But if she ever betrays—" She glanced at Ye Qing, a flash of killing intent flickering in her eyes, "I will personally send her on her way."

dialogue.content:
Chen Ling's spectral form observed this scene, her eyes filled with complex emotions. When Chen Ji turned to her, she shook her head, her voice breaking: "Brother, I cannot stand by your side like they do... I am the Heavenly Fate Key; my existence interferes with the Tianji Record's foresight."

Her spectral form trembled slightly: "All these years, the Holy Sect has been conducting experiments on me. Countless seals have been planted within my body. I... I might lose control at any moment."

Chen Ji gazed at his sister's spectral form, then suddenly extended his hand through the illusory image, gently cradling her virtual cheek. His gesture was so tender, as if truly touching a real young maiden.

"Silly child." His voice was low yet resolute, "Do you think I sought the Heavenly Fate Key for no reason? Because you are that very key. The completeness of the Tianji Record requires your unlocking." He paused, "You are not a burden; you are the key. Without you, nothing has meaning."

text.content:
At this moment, the Tianji Record suddenly emitted a deafening roar. Everyone looked up to see the suspended pages frantically turning, with the fifth page blazing with dazzling golden light—knowledge sealed for countless years, now awaiting its moment of unlocking.

Master Mo's voice resounded in Chen Ji's mind, carrying unprecedented excitement: "The time has come. The seal on the fifth page has loosened—because of your sister, because of your allies, because of the bonds you've forged between you." His voice trembled slightly, "But unlocking requires a price: a vow of shared destiny to intertwine everyone's fates."

choice.prompt: The fifth page of the Tianji Record requires a vow of shared destiny to unlock. How will you initiate this vow?

choices.description: Using essence blood as the guide, binding everyone's destiny through the power of Bloodline. Once the vow is made, there is absolutely no possibility of retreat.
choices.visible_cost: Each person sacrifices ten years of lifespan
choices.visible_reward: With Bloodline connected, in times of danger you can instantly sense each other's location and state
choices.risk_hint: This covenant will be eternally inscribed in the depths of the soul, impossible to dissolve

text.content:
Chen Ji bit his fingertip without hesitation, allowing a drop of crimson essence blood to fall onto the Tianji Record. Su Qingyao followed closely, and Ye Qing stepped forward, slicing her wrist. Three streams of blood intertwined in the air, transforming into a brilliant crimson light.

Though Chen Ling's spectral form could not shed blood, at Chen Ji's gesture, she merged her illusory Spiritual Consciousness into the light. "With blood as the guide, with the soul as the witness—" Chen Ji's voice was low and solemn, "From this day forward, our destinies are connected, life and death intertwined!"

choices.description: Using the divine soul as an anchor, connecting everyone's consciousness on a deeper level. From now on, you can share partial perceptions and memories.
choices.visible_cost: Each person endures the agony of soul-tearing
choices.visible_reward: With souls connected, you can share perceptions during battle, even providing consciousness assistance to each other in times of crisis
choices.risk_hint: If one person's divine soul is damaged, others will also feel the pain

text.content:
Chen Ji closed his eyes, his Spiritual Consciousness transforming into a wisp of ethereal smoke that delved into the Tianji Record. In the next moment, Su Qingyao, Ye Qing, and even Chen Ling far away in the Holy Sect, all felt a strange yet gentle current of consciousness flow into their Mental Seas.

It was an uncanny connection—they could sense each other's emotional fluctuations, and borrow a trace of each other's power at critical moments. "With the soul as the anchor, with the heart as the witness—" Chen Ji's voice echoed through everyone's Mental Sea, "From this day forward, our consciousness is connected, our wisdom shared!"

choices.description: Using each person's Heavenly Fate Value as the cost, binding all their destinies together. From now on, sharing weal and woe, bearing karma together.
choices.visible_cost: Each person consumes 50 points of Heavenly Fate
choices.visible_reward: Destinies connected, fortune shared, any fate curse targeting one person will be divided among all
choices.risk_hint: When the total Heavenly Fate Value decreases, the overall fortune will be affected

text.content:
Chen Ji raised his hand, spiritual power凝聚ing above the Tianji Record into an enigmatic formation pattern of heavenly fate. The pattern slowly rotated, beginning to absorb the heavenly fate power from everyone present.

Su Qingyao stepped forward first, placing her hand on the formation pattern. Her Heavenly Fate transformed into a cyan light that merged into it. Ye Qing followed closely, black aura intertwining with the cyan light. Although Chen Ling couldn't make physical contact, she spread her arms wide in the light and shadow, pouring her incomplete heavenly fate into it.

"Witnessed by heavenly fate, bound by karma—" Chen Ji's voice rang through the clouds, "From this day forward, our destinies are intertwined, sharing fortune and misfortune together!"

The moment the oath fell, the heavens and earth changed color.

The fifth page of the Tianji Record suddenly burst forth with dazzling light, and the knowledge sealed for who knows how many tens of thousands of years surged into Chen Ji's Mental Sea like a breaching flood. He groaned, blood seeping from his nose, but the light in his eyes grew brighter and brighter.

It was an image—a vision of ultimate prophecy. In that image, the Eye of Heavenly Dao materialized, obscuring the entire firmament. And beneath that firmament, five figures stood shoulder to shoulder, facing an enemy beyond imagination.

"This... is the final battle?" Su Qingyao's voice carried a tremor, for she too had seen the same image through their connection.

dialogue.content:
Mo Xiansheng's voice echoed in Chen Ji's mind, carrying unprecedented solemnity and anticipation: "The knowledge of the fifth page has been unsealed. But this is merely the beginning—the Tianji Record contains thirteen pages in total, each corresponding to an ultimate power."

His voice paused: "And the fifth page tells you the truth about that higher existence. It is not a single being, but..." Mo Xiansheng's voice suddenly became labored, "an entire civilization. The Tianji Record is merely one of the seeds it has planted across countless worlds. The realm you inhabit, in its eyes, is nothing more than an experimental field."

Chen Ji slowly opened his eyes, looking at everyone present—Su Qingyao, Ye Qing, Chen Ling's light and shadow. He suddenly smiled, that smile carrying a hint of释然 yet also resolution.

"An experimental field?" his voice was terrifyingly calm, "Then we shall make this experiment completely spiral out of control." He surveyed the crowd, "You have all seen that image. The ultimate battle is at our doorstep."

He took a deep breath: "So, I ask once more—are you truly ready? Once we embark on this path, there is no possibility of turning back."

choice.prompt: Before initiating the final oath, Chen Ji gave everyone one last chance to choose. How will you face this final decision?

choices.description: Since we have chosen this path, we will walk it to the end. No matter how perilous the road ahead, I will never retreat.
choices.visible_reward: The Fate Community completely takes shape, everyone's will is firm, combat power greatly enhanced
choices.risk_hint: Once we fail, we will fall into endless ruin

dialogue.content:
Su Qingyao was the first to speak, her voice resolute: "In this life of mine, Su Qingyao has never known what it means to look back." She looked at Chen Ji, her eyes filled with determination, "Since I chose to follow you, I never planned to leave alive."

Ye Qing also stepped forward, a bewitching smile curling at her lips: "Same here. From the moment I decided to betray that existence, I wagered my life on you."

text.content:
Chen Ling's light and shadow flickered slightly, her voice gentle yet firm: "Brother, whatever happens, I will stand by your side."

Chen Ji looked at them, an unprecedented warmth swelling in his heart. He nodded, turned to face the floating Tianji Record, his voice low and solemn: "Since it is so—I, Chen Ji, today establish a Fate Community with all of you. Not seeking to live together, but to die together!"

choices.description: I am willing to fight to the end, but please promise me—if things become untenable, you must survive.
choices.visible_reward: If the battle fails, everyone has an escape route to regroup

dialogue.content:
Su Qingyao frowned: "Are you leaving us a retreat route? Or are you the one who wants to retreat?" Her tone carried a hint of dissatisfaction.

Chen Ji shook his head: "Neither. I simply don't want to see any of you die for me." His voice was low, "If one day, I become a burden to you all—"

text.content:
Before he could finish, Su Qingyao stepped forward, reaching out to cover his mouth. Her eyes were slightly red, but her voice carried unwavering resolve: "Don't say any more. Whether we live or die, we will be together."

Ye Qing also stepped forward, placing her hand on Su Qingyao's shoulder: "He's right. We are a Fate Community, not your burden."

Chen Ling's light and shadow drifted close, gently encircling Chen Ji's waist—though she couldn't touch any physical entity, that warmth was undeniably real.

The moment the oath fell, the Tianji Record trembled violently once more. The fifth page slowly unfurled, and upon it appeared not text, but a flowing image—in that image, five figures stood shoulder to shoulder on a ruins, facing a terrifying existence descending from the depths of the heavens.

"This is... the Ultimate Prophecy." Mo Xiansheng's voice echoed in Chen Ji's mind, "But remember, prophecy only shows one possibility. Fate... is not set in stone."

The image flashed past, but everyone记住了那一幕—在那场决战中，五道身影中没有一个人倒下。但代价是什么，画面中并没有显示.

dialogue.content:
Suddenly, the sky darkened once more.

Countless eyes reappeared in the Nine Heavens, but this time, they were no longer mere observation—they carried a hint of... amusement.

It was a condescending, contemptuous amusement, as if saying: "Interesting, you actually dared to form a community of destiny."

An invisible pressure descended once more, more terrifying than any time before. Su Qingyao, Ye Qing, and even Chen Ling's light shadow felt their breath catch. But Chen Ji simply stood there, gazing calmly at the sky, a cold smile curving his lips.

"What are you laughing at?" The voice rang directly in everyone's mind, cold and majestic, "A mere ant dares to provoke the Heavenly Dao?"

Chen Ji spoke slowly, his voice not loud yet clearly reaching every presence: "I laugh because you have finally deigned to look at us directly." His eyes gleamed with sharp brilliance, "Remember this day—because from this moment, the chess game you have arranged will be overturned by our own hands."

He turned to look at everyone beside him, his voice low yet firm: "Everyone, the community of destiny is now officially established. The next battle—we will strike directly at the heart."

text.content:
As the words fell, the Tianji Record suddenly burst forth with dazzling radiance. The knowledge of the fifth page surged into Chen Ji's Mental Sea like a tide, merging with all the knowledge he had previously obtained, forming a complete system.

He felt his strength rapidly increasing—not an elevation in Combat Power, but a deepening comprehension of the laws of heaven and earth. The threads of destiny became clearly visible in his eyes, every strand of cause and effect distinguishable.

"This is... the power of the fifth page of the Tianji Record." Mo Xiansheng's voice carried a hint of relief, "From now on, you will be able to see the direction of destiny. Though only three breaths of the future—at this point, it is enough."

Chen Ji clenched his fist, feeling the power surging within him. He gazed toward the distant horizon, where a familiar yet dangerous aura was approaching—Ling Yuan, the old Sect Master of Tianqing Sect, could no longer hold back his move.

The gears of destiny began to accelerate their rotation. And they, were already prepared to welcome the storm.
